class Recorder:
    def __init__(self, codes=None):
        self.codes = codes or {}
        self.calls = []

    def __call__(self, root, run):
        self.calls.append(run)
        print(f'RUN {run.label}')
        return self.codes.get(run.label, 0)


def git(root, *args):
    subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=root, check=True, capture_output=True)


def make_repo(root: Path, files: dict, staged=True):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    git(root, 'init', '-q')
    for rel, text in files.items():
        p = root / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(text)
    if staged:
        git(root, 'add', '-A')
    return root

        pytest.skip('baseline commit 456e3fb not available')
    lines = proc.stdout.splitlines()
    picked = lines[65:125] + [lines[144]]
    expected = set()
